description: Search and Rescue teaches how lost people are found: first aid for searchers and subjects, trip plans and signaling, maps, GPS and coordinate systems, how SAR teams and incident command work, and planning and carrying out a practice search.

safety.note: Practice searches are simulations with adult leadership; real searches are run by trained responders.

outlineNote: Search and Rescue was updated for 2026 and the excerpts’ numbering was inconsistent, so no requirement outline is published yet. Topics include hazards and first aid, staying found and signaling, maps and coordinates, kinds of SAR teams, the Incident Command System, and a practice search.
